description: Project scaffolding, dependency setup, and data acquisition module. Establish the full project structure with pyproject.toml, all package directories, and build a data fetcher that downloads 10+ years of NASDAQ data (QQQ, TQQQ, and constituent proxies) via yfinance. Include data validation and caching.
steps: Set Python version to 3.11.15 via pyenv local in /projects/sandbox/yo
Create pyproject.toml with dependencies: pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, yfinance, matplotlib, seaborn, tabulate, pytest, ruff
Create full directory structure: src/quant_research/{data,hypotheses,testing,validation,strategy,robustness,reporting}/ each with __init__.py
Create tests/ directory with conftest.py providing shared fixtures (sample OHLCV dataframes)

Create src/quant_research/data/fetcher.py - DataFetcher class that: downloads NASDAQ data (QQQ as primary proxy, also ^IXIC) for 10 years via yfinance, validates data completeness, handles missing values, caches to local parquet files in data/cache/, provides train/test split functionality

Create src/quant_research/data/features.py - FeatureEngine class that computes derived features from OHLCV: returns at multiple horizons, volatility measures (realized vol, Parkinson, Garman-Klass), volume metrics (relative volume, volume MA ratios, VWAP proxy), gap measurements (overnight gaps), session indicators (day of week, month, quarter), technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR)
Create tests/test_data.py with tests for DataFetcher (mock yfinance) and FeatureEngine (using fixture data)
Create .gitignore with appropriate entries (data/cache/, results/, __pycache__, .pyenv, etc.)
Run uv sync to install all dependencies and verify the environment works
Run pytest to verify tests pass
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml exists with all required dependencies
All package directories exist with __init__.py files
DataFetcher can download and cache NASDAQ data
FeatureEngine computes all specified derived features from OHLCV data
Data limitations are documented in module docstrings - explicitly noting that OHLCV+volume cannot provide true order flow data
findings: Added pyarrow>=14.0 as a dependency (required by pandas for parquet I/O support). The deprecated tool.uv.dev-dependencies field in pyproject.toml produces a warning but functions correctly. All 31 tests pass.
